scheme_name: Fish Extension, Research, and Training Scheme
occupation: related entity in the fisheries sector
other_conditions: Prior experience or relevant qualifications in the fisheries field
Valid bank account for fund disbursement
From a region identified under the scheme by the Department of Fisheries
Preference for applicants from rural and underdeveloped areas
benefits_summary: Provides financial subsidies for training, fish seed production, fish farming, research, equipment incentives, identity cards, and public awareness support.
